mechanism: Ibuprofen reduces renal blood flow and glomerular filtration rate, potentially decreasing piperacillin clearance and increasing beta-lactam antibiotic levels; NSAIDs also increase risk of acute kidney injury which impairs antibiotic elimination.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) closely during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative analgesia if possible or use lowest effective NSAID dose for shortest duration.
